## The Harmonic Oscillator

We can express the system using standard LaTeX notation:

$$ \ddot{x} + \omega^2 x = 0 $$

### Interactive Simulation
Adjust the slider below to see the phase space update in real time.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Create an interactive slider right in the markdown text
viewof omega = Inputs.range([0.1, 5], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Angular Frequency (ω)"})

// Render a dynamic SVG or canvas plot based on 'omega'
Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.line(d3.range(0, 10, 0.1).map(t => [t, Math.sin(omega * t)]), {stroke: "blue"})
  ]
})
```
